scope: Targeted repair of the baseline mesh repartitioning discontinuity; not qualification of the full staircase model for physical optimizer ranking.

policy.name: anchored-transverse-lattice-v1
policy.description: Preserve physical background coordinates and insert endpoint fitting knots locally; grading inserts points without repartitioning whole intervals.

geometry_diagnostics.endpoint_fitting: local knot insertion; background points within merge tolerance are replaced
geometry_diagnostics.geometry_limitations: staircase material boundaries and knot merging remain discretization errors; shared transverse refinements affect both electrodes
geometry_diagnostics.axial_sampling: cell centers; exact endpoint sections held in first and last cells

tests.source_environment: Isolated copy of current P011 source, with the missing P006 runtime dependency restored from the previous audit. User checkout P006 state preserved.

limitations: Local staircase material classification remains discontinuous at some designs; the coarse test taper shows a 0.77% objective jump under an infinitesimal width change.
The test taper changes objective by 24.8% from coarse to medium, so broad mesh convergence and physical ranking are not established.
Shared transverse endpoint refinements still affect both electrodes.
One unchanged-cathode diagnostic is rejected by the unchanged OpenFOAM tet-quality threshold; failure is preserved and no physical objective is reported.
The taper-fine case was generated but not executed; it is not evidence of convergence.
Local CFD uses OpenCFD v2312 Docker arm64; native Rivium has not been rerun with v3.
guidance: Preserve stopped v1/v2 journals. The targeted fix does not justify restarting a large physical benchmarking campaign before further mesh/model verification.
